acceptanceCriteria: procgroup ignores CLD_TRAPPED/CLD_STOPPED/CLD_CONTINUED waitid reports (shared helper with groupreap or an equivalent check) and a Darwin test stops then continues a leader and observes no early exit.
body:
Found during V1-0373 (batch L, 2026-10-08). internal/procgroup/process_posix.go:38 waitProcessExitUnreaped calls waitid(P_PID, WEXITED|WNOWAIT) and returns nil on any errno 0. On Darwin, waitid can report a stopped/continued child despite WEXITED (golang/go#19314; observed on Darwin 25 as si_code CLD_STOPPED). internal/groupreap/waitid.go (stateChangeOnly) now polls past si_code 4..6; procgroup has the same pattern without that check, so a SIGSTOPped leader is treated as exited and terminateProcessGroup escalates to SIGKILL of a still-live group.

Confirmed by code comparison at batch L (b26aea28); no procgroup runtime reproduction yet.

completion.reason: Merged in beamfall/corvint#702 (merge b2a0b8c6): procgroup waitProcessExitUnreaped ignores Darwin waitid si_code 4..6 reports; new test fails on base, passes; independent review PASS; CEM sealed. Darwin arm64 only. Remaining copies filed as V1-1046.

title: procgroup waitProcessExitUnreaped treats a Darwin waitid stop/continue report as an exit
